subject: Using absl::btree_map for PositionMap (#851)
reason: The change only swaps the transient per-token PositionMap (and the matching FlatPositionMap::Create parameter) from std::map<Position, FieldMask> to absl::btree_map<Position, FieldMask>. Both are ordered maps over uint32_t with identical comparator, iteration order, size() and try_emplace semantics, so the serialized FlatPositionMap bytes, the metadata counters, and every FT.SEARCH reply are unchanged. The one semantic difference between the containers, iterator/reference invalidation on insert, is unreached: the only mutation site (text_index.cc:204) uses the try_emplace iterator immediately
